Medical History

- Current health concerns and risk factors:
  - Acute onset lip swelling after eating prawn soup (~30 minutes after ingestion); progressive swelling of upper lip (initially left corner).
  - Difficulty breathing and lightheadedness/dizziness reported; possible chest tightness.
  - Suspected anaphylactic reaction by clinician.
  - Past similar event ~1 year ago with facial swelling and breathing difficulty after eating (patient was intoxicated at that time).
  - Known peanut allergy since childhood; mother reported a severe allergic reaction in childhood that required an injection/hospital when patient was ~6 years old.

Management Plan

- Immediate actions and recommendations provided:
  - Clinician advised emergency ambulance/ED attendance for suspected anaphylaxis and attempted to call ambulance; instructed patient/mother to call emergency services (999) immediately.

  - Advised patient to remain with another person until ambulance arrives.

- Follow-up and further management recommended:
